label: session-metric
note: First boundary recorded with the per-session rework metric (docs/decisions.md 2026-08-05; the partition shipped in c6815cd). NOT a release cut - plugin.json stays 0.28.1 and no changelog release was cut for it. Rework here is runs per SESSION: entries are split at every APPROVED or RUBRIC_PASSED verdict, because a passing verdict terminates a retry loop, so one file holding two of them holds two independent sessions. DO NOT compare this markers rework figure against v0.24.0 or v0.25.0 - both hold the pre-fix runsPerArtifact key measured per LOG FILE, which overstated rework everywhere and worst on test-write-review (2.38 per file against 1.25 per session across the six-repo corpus). Comparing across the two shapes repeats the exact error this metric was corrected to remove; treat the older pair as a closed audit record, not as a baseline. The v0.25.0 marker is still the boundary for the wave-2 evaluation and carries its own steering note - use compare --since v0.25.0 for that, since compare now defaults to this newer marker. First-attempt failure is per session from here on too.
